source_title: AI SSD Procurement Capacity Estimated to Exceed 45 EB in 2024; NAND Flash Suppliers Accelerate Process Upgrades, Says TrendForce
claim_relevant_visible_text: AI-related SSD procurement capacity will exceed 45 EB in 2024.
researcher_paraphrase: TrendForce estimated full-year 2024 AI-related SSD procurement capacity above 45 EB.
precision_guard: This August 2024 figure is a contemporaneous full-year estimate for AI-related SSD procurement capacity. It is not interchangeable with the April QLC-enterprise-SSD 30 EB forecast because product scope differs, and it is not a realized full-year Outcome.
authority_boundary: TrendForce is methodological-primary for its own market estimate and scope; the figure is not a supplier primary shipment ledger.
